It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you all to the spacious and ecofriendly campus of Hatsingimari College. It is the primier institute of higher education at the heart of the newly formed south salmara mankachar district head quarter which impart quality higher education to the peoples of vast area of south bank of the then Dhubri district and West Garo hills and South West Garo hills districts of Meghalaya. This college catering the thirst of knowledge in the backward International Indo-Bangla boarder region accommodating about two thousand students from the state of Assam and Meghalaya in the Arts and Science stream consisting of twelve departments. This is the only institute of higher education having undergraduate science stream in the district. This college become the knowledge hub for the South Salmara Mankachar District as well as a greater part of Meghalaya which is a great initiative by some great son of the region in the year 1987.
As it is a newly provincialised College, we don’t have sufficient infrastructures and facilities for our students and staff still we try our best for holistic development of our students. Hatsingimari College fraternity welcome the aspiring students and suggest them to put their best effort to be responsible  and successful human being rather than expecting everyone to be at the top. We expect you to learn the concept, to be innovative and to learn value based moral education without which learning is incomplete.
Our motto is not just to teach the curriculum rather it is the holistic development of all the students. In this journey, our highly acclaimed faculties from leading universities of the country will guide you throughout. Parallel to the traditional curricular activities the college maintain a vibrant atmosphere of co-curricular activities for which we have a well qualified physical education teacher.
Hatsingimari college is preparing for NAAC accreditation for the first time and hence all its teaching and non-teaching staff have been working day and night to obtain a prestigious grade in the said assessment and alround upliftment of the college. In this crucial moment we expect constructive suggestions and criticism from the students, alumni, guardians and all other stakeholders of the college.
Hatsingimari College is preparing itself for the New Education Policy (NEP)-2020, a noble endeavour to provide effective, practical and quality education to be implemented shortly by the government of India. In this regard an NEP task force has already been constituted and they have been working relentlessly.
Last but not the least, discipline which I believe is the key to any educational institution and I have taken a pledge to maintain strict discipline in the college premise so that everything flourishes in a decent way.
Once again, I welcome all concerned to this Institution of Higher Learning and request all to extend alround co-operation in making this College a distinguished Centre of Higher Learning in the south-western part of the state of Assam.
From The Principal's Desk
Dr. Shaher Ali

About The College
No power is greater than the power of knowledge. It is the quest
for knowledge which has brought the human beings from their aborigine stage to the
stage of internet, wi-fi, in the 21st century of digital world .The aim of education is the
knowledge not only of facts but also of values .It ignites human soul with the rays of
wisdom thereby serving the man kind to live a fruitful life .It creates the empire of the mind.
Education survives when it is learned and even when it is forgotten we, the teaching
community of Hatsingimari College has been imparting higher education to thousands of
knowledge-thirsty students since its inception, 1987. The college has been transmitting
knowledge by creating human resources who support not only themselves but to the
mankind as a whole exercising their self-reliance, leadership, positive outlook
perseverance, patience, honesty, responsibility, morality and so on. Our imparted
knowledge makes the students community bold enough in facing the challenges in their
lives. We imbibe the spirit of enquiry in the minds of the young students to make
themselves familiar with new arena of knowledge. Merely acquiring theoretical knowledge
is not enough for the students. With a view to make them practical, we inspire the
students to exercise their inherent genius cultured by education in their present crisis and
the crisis to come. We inspire them to think and to do positive. Our best effort is to make
